verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs describe an official OpenAPI repository (github.com/Adyen/adyen-openapi) with specs for every public API. The docs call these specs the single source of truth and explicitly recommend them as LLM context alongside Adyen MCP. The probe's 404s on guessed docs-domain paths do not contradict this, because the specs are published on GitHub, not at those paths. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the GitHub spec files can be downloaded and are complete.
